disposition.rationale: The public record is sufficient for commissioner, provider class, programme category, pathway, comparator, timing, horizon, and market-share context. It is not sufficient to invent an actual displaced programme or confidential net-price baseline.
disposition.fallback: Use the public NICE treatment-substitution assumptions as a labelled research scenario and keep parameter d synthetic or unidentifiable.
disposition.refresh_rule: Repeat the grey-literature search when TA1121, NHS England specialised-commissioning publications, local implementation records, or indexed FOI holdings change. Invalidate downstream calibrated outputs if any price, programme, comparator, horizon, or source hash changes.
